claims.text: Masked Document Generation (MDG) is a task that learns to recover a document with a masked span of tokens.
MDG involves masking a continuous sub-sequence of a document and aims to restore the original document form.
In MDG, the length of the masked span is sampled from a uniform distribution, and the masking strategy avoids using [MASK] tokens to maintain document comprehensibility.
